75300.meaning1: reached complete extinguishing; attained absolute quenching

examples.text: pajjena katena attanā, parinibbānagato vitiṇṇakaṅkho, vibhavañ'ca bhavañ'ca vippahāya, vusitavā khīṇapunabbhavo sa bhikkhu.
bāhitvā sabbapāpakāni, vimalo sādhusamāhito ṭhit'atto, saṃsāram'aticca kevalī so, asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.

75302.meaning1: causing disturbance; making move to and fro

75303.commentary: (SNPa) ninhāya… nhātako'ti ettha pana yo ajjhattabahiddhāsaṅkhāte sabbasmim'pi āyatanaloke ajjhatta-bahiddh'ārammaṇa-vasena uppattirahāni sabbapāpakāni maggañāṇena ninhāya dhovitvā tāya ninhātapāpakatāya taṇhādiṭṭhikappehi kappiyesu devamanussesu kappaṃ na eti, taṃ nhātakam'āhū'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: ninahāya sabbapāpakāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca sabbaloke, devamanussesu kappiyesu, kappaṃ n'eti tam'āhu nhātako'ti.

75304.grammar: pr, irreg form of sajjati, pass, intrans
75304.meaning1: is attached; is enmeshed; is entangled
75304.commentary: (NIDD1a) tatra tatra sajjatī'ti tesu tesu ārammaṇesu laggati.

examples.text: āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.

75305.meaning1: Brahma's realm; world of the gods
75305.commentary: (SNPa) dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettan'ti ettha ca dev'ūpagaṃ kammaṃ dibbaṃ, manuss'ūpagaṃ kammaṃ mānusakaṃ, brahm'ūpagaṃ kammaṃ brahmakhettan'ti vaṇṇayanti.

examples.text: khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75306.meaning1: action conducive to the Brahma world
75306.commentary: (SNPa) visesato pana saṅgahetubhūtaṃ aṭṭha-kām'āvacara-kusala-cetanā-bhedaṃ dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca nava-mahaggata-kusala-cetanā-bhedañ'ca brahmakosaṃ viceyya.

examples.text: kosāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakosaṃ, sabbakosamūlabandhanā pamutto, kusalo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75307.meaning1: root of bondage to all seeds (of action); source of attachment to every action
75307.commentary: (SNPa) tato imāya maggabhāvanāya avijjā-bhavataṇh'ādi-bhedā sabbakosānaṃ mūlabandhanā pamutto

examples.text: kosāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakosaṃ, sabbakosamūlabandhanā pamutto, kusalo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75308.meaning1: all felt experience; every feeling tone; all (pleasant, unpleasant or neutral) sensations
75308.commentary: (SNPa) tyā vedapaccayā vā aññathā vā uppajjanti vedanā, tāsu sabbavedanāsu vītarāgo hoti

examples.text: vedāni viceyya kevalāni, samaṇānaṃ yān'idh'atthi brāhmaṇānaṃ, sabbavedanāsu vītarāgo, sabbaṃ vedam'aticca vedagū so.

75309.meaning1: proliferation, name and form; various opinions, mental and physical phenomena
75309.commentary: (SNPa) so ca anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ ajjhattaṃ attano santāne taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhi-bhedaṃ papañcaṃ tappaccayā nāmarūpañ'ca anicc'ānupassan'ādīhi anuvicca anuviditvā

examples.text: anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, sabbarogamūlabandhanā pamutto, anuvidito tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75310.meaning1: root of disease; origin of illness
75310.commentary: (SNPa) na kevalañ'ca ajjhattaṃ, bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, parasantāne ca imassa nāmarūparogassa mūlaṃ avijjābhavataṇh'ādiṃ

examples.text: anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, sabbarogamūlabandhanā pamutto, anuvidito tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75311.meaning1: root of bondage to all disease; source of attachment to every ill
75311.commentary: (SNPa) tam'eva vā papañcaṃ anuvicca tāya bhāvanāya sabbesaṃ rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, sabbasmā vā rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, avijjā-bhavataṇh'ādi-bhedā

examples.text: anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, sabbarogamūlabandhanā pamutto, anuvidito tādi pavuccate tath'attā.

75312.meaning1: root of bondage to all attachment; source of attachment to all clinging
75312.commentary: (SNPa) so sabbasmā saṅgānaṃ mūlabhūtā sabbasaṅgānaṃ vā mūlabhūtā bandhanā pamutto

examples.text: yass'assu lunāni bandhanāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca saṅgamūlaṃ, sabbasaṅgamūlabandhanā pamutto, ājāniyo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.

75313.commentary: (SNPa) tass'attho, cattāri āsavāni dve ca ālayāni paññāsatthena chetvā vidvā viññū vibhāvī catumaggañāṇī so punabbhavavasena na upeti gabbhaseyyaṃ, kañci yoniṃ na upagacchati, kām'ādi-bhedañ'ca saññaṃ tividhaṃ.

examples.text: chetvā āsavāni ālayāni, vidvā so na upeti gabbhaseyyaṃ, saññaṃ tividhaṃ panujja paṅkaṃ, kappaṃ n'eti tam'āhu ariyo'ti.

75314.meaning1: wanders with complete comprehension; going around fully understanding

examples.text: dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, m'āyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.

75315.meaning1: greed and anger; desire and wrath

examples.text: dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, m'āyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.

75316.meaning1: dependent on the doctrines of ascetics
75316.commentary: (SNPa) yasmā ca tāni aññatitthiyasamaṇānaṃ pavādabhūtāni satthāni sitāni upadisitabbavasena, na uppattivasena.

examples.text: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādasitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.

75317.meaning1: should be shown; should be indicated

75318.meaning1: dependent on the doctrines of ascetics
75318.commentary: (SNPa) yasmā ca tāni aññatitthiyasamaṇānaṃ pavādabhūtāni satthāni sitāni upadisitabbavasena, na uppattivasena.

examples.text: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādanissitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.

75319.meaning1: reliant on verbal expression and perception
75319.commentary: (SNPa) tāni yasmā sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā saha brahmajāle vuttadvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhigatāni gahetvā tesaṭṭhi honti, yasmā ca tāni aññatitthiyasamaṇānaṃ pavādabhūtāni satthāni sitāni upadisitabbavasena, na uppattivasena. uppattivasena pana yadetaṃ itthī puriso'ti saññ'akkharaṃ vohāranāmaṃ, yā c'āyaṃ micchāparivitakk'ānussav'ādi-vasena evarūpena attanā bhavitabban'ti bālānaṃ viparītasaññā uppajjati, tadubhayanissitāni tesaṃ vasena uppajjanti, na attapaccakkhāni.

examples.text: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādasitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.

75320.meaning1: crossed the dark deluge; transcended the flood of ignorance
75320.commentary: (SNPa) oghatam'agā oghatamaṃ ogh'andhakāraṃ agā atikkanto. ogh'antam'agā'ti'pi pāṭho, oghānaṃ antaṃ agā

examples.text: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādasitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.

75321.meaning1: greatest of the great; giant among giants; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: tassa te nāganāgassa, mahāvīrassa bhāsato, sabbe dev'ānumodanti, ubho nāradapabbatā.

75322.commentary: (SNPa) nāradapabbatā'ti te'pi kira dve devagaṇā paññavanto, te'pi anumodantī'ti sabbaṃ pasādena ca namakkārakaraṇaṃ bhaṇati.

examples.text: tassa te nāganāgassa, mahāvīrassa bhāsato, sabbe dev'ānumodanti, ubho nāradapabbatā.

75323.grammar: abs of vasaṃ karoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
75323.meaning1: having mastered; having subdued; having brought under control

examples.text: brahmabhūto atitulo, mārasenappamaddano, sabb'āmitte vasīkatvā, modāmi akutobhayo.
yaṃ taṃ saraṇam'āgamha, ito aṭṭhami cakkhuma, sattarattena bhagavā, dant'amha tava sāsane.

75325.commentary: (NIDD1a) sabbaṃ bhedanapariyantan'ti pakkāpakkaṃ sabbaṃ bhedanaṃ bhijjapariyantaṃ avasānaṃ assā'ti bhedanapariyantaṃ.

examples.text: yathā'pi kumbhakārassa, katā mattikabhājanā, sabbe bhedanapariyantā, evaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ.

75326.grammar: prp of na sampassati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi, āgatassa gatassa vā, ubho ante asampassaṃ, niratthaṃ paridevasi.

75327.commentary: (SNPa) idāni niratthaṃ paridevasī'ti ettha vuttaparidevanāya niratthakabhāvaṃ sādhento paridevayamāno ce'tiādim'āha.

examples.text: paridevayamāno ce, kiñci'd'atthaṃ udabbahe, sammūḷho hiṃsam'attānaṃ, kayirā ce naṃ vicakkhaṇo.

75328.meaning1: coming under the power; coming under the control (of)

examples.text: aññe'pi passa gamine, yathākamm'ūpage nare, maccuno vasam'āgamma, phandant'ev'idha pāṇino.
yathā saraṇam'ādittaṃ, vārinā parinibbaye, evam'pi dhīro sapañño, paṇḍito kusalo naro, khippam'uppatitaṃ sokaṃ, vāto tūlaṃ'va dhaṃsaye.
abbuḷhasallo asito, santiṃ pappuyya cetaso, sabbasokaṃ atikkanto, asoko hoti nibbuto'ti.

examples.text: acirappakkantassa ca kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭo ahosi, sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ, muggamattiyo hutvā kaḷāyamattiyo ahesuṃ, kaḷāyamattiyo hutvā kol'aṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ
appamatto ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahattaro kali, yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye.
yo so mahattaro khandho, palujjeyya aniccatā, tathā bhikkhunisaṅghassa, gotamī parinibbutā.

75333.meaning1: aspect of greed; quality of desire
75333.commentary: (SNPa) tāsaṃ iminā suttena saddhiṃ ekasaṅgahatthaṃ ayam'uddeso yo lobhaguṇe anuyutto'tiādi. tattha paṭhamagāthāya tāva guṇo'ti niddiṭṭhattā anekakkhattuṃ pavattattā vā lobho'y'eva lobhaguṇo, taṇhāy'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: yo lobhaguṇe anuyutto, so vacasā paribhāsati aññe, asaddho kadariyo avadaññū, macchari pesuṇiyaṃ anuyutto.

mukhadugga vibhūta anariya, bhūnahu pāpaka dukkaṭakāri, puris'anta kalī avajāta, mā bahubhāṇi-idha nerayiko'si.

75341.commentary: (SNPa) idāni yaṃ dukkhaṃ mando passati, taṃ pakāsento ayosaṅku-samāhataṭṭhānan'ti-ādim'āha.

examples.text: ayosaṅku-samāhataṭṭhānaṃ, tiṇhadhāramayasūlam'upeti, atha tattaayoguḷasannibhaṃ, bhojanam'atthi tathā patirūpaṃ.

75342.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ upento ca tatth'eva ādittāya lohapathaviyā nipajjāpetvā nirayapālehi pañcasu ṭhānesu ākoṭiyamānaṃ tattaṃ khilasaṅkhātaṃ tiṇhadhāramayasūlam'upeti

examples.text: ayosaṅku-samāhataṭṭhānaṃ, tiṇhadhāramayasūlam'upeti, atha tattaayoguḷasannibhaṃ, bhojanam'atthi tathā patirūpaṃ.

75343.commentary: (SNPa) ayo'ti lohaṃ. guḷasannibhan'ti beluvasaṇṭhānaṃ. ayogahaṇena c'ettha tambalohaṃ, itarena ayoguḷaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: ayosaṅku-samāhataṭṭhānaṃ, tiṇhadhāramayasūlam'upeti, atha tattaayoguḷasannibhaṃ, bhojanam'atthi tathā patirūpaṃ.

na + abhijavati

examples.text: atha pubbalohitamisse, tattha kiṃ paccati kibbisakārī, yaṃ yaṃ disakaṃ adhiseti, tattha kilissati samphusamāno.

75355.meaning1: all the same; all alike; all similar
75355.commentary: (SNPa) sabbasamā hi samantakapallā'ti yasmā tassā kumbhiyā uparibhāge'pi nikujjitattā sabbattha samā samantato kaṭāhā, tasmā apagantuṃ tīraṃ n'atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: puḷav'āvasathe salilasmiṃ, tattha kiṃ paccati kibbisakārī, gantuṃ na hi tīram'ap'atthi, sabbasamā hi samantakapallā.

75356.meaning1: surrounding frying pans; pots all around
75356.commentary: (SNPa) sabbasamā hi samantakapallā'ti yasmā tassā kumbhiyā uparibhāge'pi nikujjitattā sabbattha samā samantato kaṭāhā, tasmā apagantuṃ tīraṃ n'atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: puḷav'āvasathe salilasmiṃ, tattha kiṃ paccati kibbisakārī, gantuṃ na hi tīram'ap'atthi, sabbasamā hi samantakapallā.

75357.meaning1: cut up; shredded; lacerated; torn apart
75357.commentary: (SNPa) ten'āha, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā'ti. taṃ pavisanti tato suṭṭhu chinnagattā hontī'ti.

examples.text: asipattavanaṃ pana tiṇhaṃ, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā, jivhaṃ balisena gahetvā, ārajay'ārajayā vihananti.
ayosaṅku-samāhataṭṭhānaṃ, tiṇhadhāramayasūlam'upeti, atha tattaayoguḷasannibhaṃ, bhojanam'atthi tathā patirūpaṃ.

75359.meaning1: with lacerated limbs; with shredded body parts
75359.commentary: (SNPa) ten'āha, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā'ti. taṃ pavisanti tato suṭṭhu chinnagattā hontī'ti.

examples.text: asipattavanaṃ pana tiṇhaṃ, taṃ pavisanti samucchidagattā, jivhaṃ balisena gahetvā, ārajay'ārajayā vihananti.

75361.meaning1: remainder of life; rest of existence
75361.commentary: (SNPa) jīvitasese jīvitasantatiyā vijjamānāya idha loke ṭhito'y'eva samāno

examples.text: kicchā vat'ayaṃ idha vutti, yaṃ jano phusati kibbisakārī, tasmā idha jīvitasese, kiccakaro siyā naro na cappamajje.

75362.commentary: (BVa) koṭisatānī'ti koṭīnaṃ satāni koṭisatāni. koṭisatayo'ti'pi pāṭho, tassa satakoṭiyo'ti attho.

examples.text: te gaṇitā vidūhi tilavāhā, ye padume niraye upanītā, nahutāni hi koṭiyo pañca bhavanti, dvādasa koṭisatāni pun'aññā.

75364.meaning1: who has pure, virtuous and good qualities

examples.text: yāva dukhā nirayā idha vuttā, tattha'pi tāva ciraṃ vasitabbaṃ, tasmā sucipesalasādhuguṇesu, vācaṃ manaṃ satataṃ parirakkhe'ti.

75365.meaning1: home of worms; dwelling of maggots
75365.commentary: (SNPa) puḷav'āvasathe'ti puḷavānaṃ āvāse. ayam'pi lohakumbhī'y'eva devadūte gūthanirayo'ti vuttā, tattha patitassa sūcimukhapāṇā chavi-ādīni chinditvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ khādanti.

examples.text: puḷav'āvasathe salilasmiṃ, tattha kiṃ paccati kibbisakārī, gantuṃ na hi tīram'ap'atthi, sabbasamā hi samantakapallā.

75394.commentary: (SNPa) terasāyaṃ sambodhi'y'aggan'ti sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ. tañ'hi aviparītabhāvena sammā bujjhanato sambodhi, katthaci āvaraṇābhāvena sabbañāṇ'uttamato aggan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sambodhiy'aggaṃ phusissat'āyaṃ kumāro, so dhammacakkaṃ paramavisuddhadassī, vattessat'āyaṃ bahujanahit'ānukampī, vitthārikassa bhavissati brahmacariyaṃ.
